title: Hold Hukam Under Pressure
summary: Hukam is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Like a foolish child, I have made mistakes. O Lord, You are my Father and Mother; relying on Your Mercy, Dear Lord, I have cherished and loved you
lifeApplication: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
